title: Corso recruited to the Army Foreign Technology Division

tellings.quote: Um, Corso stated that in 1960 he was recruited to the US Army's foreign technology division.

plain: Philip J. Corso, an Army officer, stated that in 1960 he was recruited into the US Army's Foreign Technology Division, a Pentagon unit for studying technology from outside the US, working under the general Arthur Trudeau. The online researcher known as UAPGerb tells this and points to Corso's official military records as backing. It matters because it would place Corso in the very office where strange recovered technology might be studied.
